lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm from an environmental group.
lines.en: Yes, hello. Is this about the environment?

lines.beaver_en: Yes. Do you often use disposable goods?
lines.learner: 네, 바빠서 일회용 컵을 매일 써요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm busy, so I use disposable cups every day.
lines.roman: ne, bappaseo irhoeyong keobeul maeil sseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그런 분이 많아요. 그런데 비닐도 문제예요.
lines.beaver_en: Many people do. But plastic is a problem too.
lines.beaver_roman: geureon buni manayo. geureonde binildo munjeyeyo.
lines.en: Plastic is convenient, so naturally people use a lot.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 하지만 이대로 가면 자연환경이 파괴돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. But if this goes on, nature will be destroyed.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. hajiman idaero gamyeon jayeonhwangyeongi pagoedwaeyo.
lines.en: Is the destruction of nature that serious?

lines.beaver_en: Yes. Pollution gets worse because of trash, too.
lines.en: When pollution is bad, health naturally gets worse.

lines.beaver: 그렇죠. 일회용품을 만들 때 에너지도 많이 들어요.
lines.beaver_en: Exactly. Making disposables also uses a lot of energy.
lines.beaver_roman: geureochyo. irhoeyongpumeul mandeul ttae eneojido mani deureoyo.
lines.en: So we're wasting energy and resources.
First, I'll start cutting down on disposables myself.

lines.beaver: 좋아요! 텀블러를 쓰는 것도 좋은 방안이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Great! Using a tumbler is also a good idea.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo! teombeulleoreul sseuneun geotdo joeun banganieyo.
lines.en: If I carry a shopping bag, I'll use less plastic too.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 다른 방법도 더 알려 드릴까요?
lines.beaver_en: Right. Shall I tell you some other ways too?
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. dareun bangbeopdo deo allyeo deurilkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 환경 보전 방법을 더 알고 싶어요.
lines.en: Yes, I want to learn more ways to protect the environment.
lines.roman: ne, hwangyeong bojeon bangbeobeul deo algo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then I'll give you this leaflet. Thank you!
lines.en: Thank you. I'll start protecting the environment today.
